clips.title: The story
paras: Along Westfall's western shore, shipwrecked sailors face murloc tribes on the beaches. Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse calls for help clearing the coast so survivors can reach land safely.

Westfall's western coast has claimed countless ships. Reefs, sudden squalls, and jagged rocks break vessels against the shoals. Survivors may cling to wreckage and crawl ashore, hoping for rescue. But murloc tribes control the beaches and show no mercy to castaways.

Captain Grayson tends the Westfall Lighthouse from a lonely outcropping southwest of the mainland. Death has bound him to the post, yet he remains watchful over passing ships and sailors in need. Murlocs make the shore deadly, from Coastrunners in the north to Tidehunters, Warriors, and Oracles in the south. Grayson calls on travelers to clear the coastline.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You probably noticed all of the shipwrecks along the coast. The Great Sea is treacherous indeed. The coast of Westfall needs to be kept clear, so that if sailors find their way to our beaches, they are safe. The Murlocs are trouble though.
Kill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners and I will see to it that you are rewarded.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Kill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners and I will see to it that you are rewarded.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend. You have quite a knack for combat. Thanks to you the Coast of Westfall is a safer place.
